title: BuildGenerators executor
description: Compiles the generators of an ng-packagr library to CommonJS and stages them (with generators.json and the generator assets) so that ng-packagr can copy them into the package.

tsConfig.description: Path of the generators tsconfig, relative to the project root.

outputPath.description: Staging directory, relative to the project root. Must be inside the project root: ng-packagr refuses to copy assets from outside of it.

generatorsDir.description: Directory of the generators, relative to the project root.
